title: Student Medication Checklist
subtitle: Capture medication identity, label match, dose schedule source, and storage custody; confirm administration record and return.
description: Student Medication records medication identity, label match, dose schedule source, storage custody, administration record, and return. Student Medication evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this student medication stage-gated verification when staff must document medication identity and label match. Reconcile dose schedule source, storage custody, administration record, and return before the student medication handoff. Use the prescriber order, pharmacy label, guardian authorization, administration schedule, locked-storage inventory, dose log, variance report, expiration check, and return receipt. This record centers the pharmacy label, prescriber or qualified order, scheduled dose, staff administration entry, supply quantity, locked custody, missed or refused event, and medication return. For student medication live use, check roster. Reconcile the student medication schedule and actual handoff times. Preserve the student medication roster and schedule. Record the student medication handoff time and instructions. Close the student medication exception queue. Verify student medication day-of-service timing. Resolve student medication real-time changes and operating handoff for student medication. Ask the assigned student medication reviewer to confirm medication identity against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Student Medication starting details
sections.guidance: Match student, medication label, qualified dose schedule, administration time, supply count, storage custody, variance record, expiration, and return. Keep any urgent student medication issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Student Medication exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current student medication facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Student Medication required checks
items: Medication identity is identified for this record
Label match matches the current request or source
Dose schedule source is ready for point-of-use staff
Storage custody limits or questions are resolved
Administration record is communicated to the responsible person
A changed student medication fact is returned for review

sections.title: Student Medication readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold student medication readiness on any failed or pending item.
